25	open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Topology TopologicalSpace
    26	
    27	namespace MilneLib
    28	namespace InvariantLocalization
    29	
    30	variable {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {G : Type*}
    31	  [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    32	  [Group G] [MulSemiringAction G A] [SMulCommClass G k A]
    33	
    34	/-- The map from a stable source open to its descended quotient open is a
    35	topological quotient map.  The proof transports the standard restriction of
    36	the global quotient map across the equality of the source open with the
    37	preimage of its descended target open. -/
    38	theorem affineInvariantQuotientMapRestrictStable_isQuotientMap [Finite G]
    39	    (U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens)
    40	    (hU : ∀ g : G, (specAction G A g).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U = U) :
    41	    Topology.IsQuotientMap
    42	      (affineInvariantQuotientMapRestrictStable
    43	        (k := k) (A := A) (G := G) U hU).base := by
    44	  let q := affineInvariantQuotientMap (k := k) (A := A) (G := G)
    45	  let W := quotientOpenOfStable (k := k) (A := A) (G := G) U hU
    46	  have hq : Topology.IsQuotientMap q.base :=
    47	    affineInvariantQuotientMap_isQuotientMap (k := k) (A := A) (G := G)
    48	  have hW :
    49	      IsOpen (W : Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra k A G)))) :=
    50	    W.is_open'
    51	  have hrestricted :
    52	      Topology.IsQuotientMap (W.1.restrictPreimage q.base) :=
    53	    hq.restrictPreimage_isOpen hW
    54	  have hpre : q ⁻¹ᵁ W = U :=
    55	    quotientOpenOfStable_preimage (k := k) (A := A) (G := G) U hU
    56	  have hset :
    57	      (U.carrier : Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))) =
    58	        q.base ⁻¹' (W.carrier : Set
    59	          (Spec (CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra k A G)))) := by
    60	    simpa [q, W] using congrArg
    61	      (fun O : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens =>
    62	        (O.carrier : Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)))) hpre.symm
    63	  let e : (U.carrier : Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))) ≃ₜ
    64	      (q.base ⁻¹' (W.carrier : Set
    65	        (Spec (CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra k A G))))) :=
    66	    Homeomorph.setCongr hset
    67	  have he : Topology.IsQuotientMap e := e.isQuotientMap
    68	  have hcomp :
    69	      Topology.IsQuotientMap ((W.1.restrictPreimage q.base) ∘ e) :=
    70	    hrestricted.comp he
    71	  have hmap :
    72	      ⇑(affineInvariantQuotientMapRestrictStable
    73	        (k := k) (A := A) (G := G) U hU).base =
    74	        (W.1.restrictPreimage q.base) ∘ e := by
    75	    funext x
    76	    apply Subtype.ext
    77	    change ((affineInvariantQuotientMapRestrictStable
    78	        (k := k) (A := A) (G := G) U hU).base x).1 =
    79	      ((W.1.restrictPreimage q.base) (e x)).1
    80	    simp only [Set.restrictPreimage]
    81	    have hfac := affineInvariantQuotientMapRestrictStable_fac
    82	      (k := k) (A := A) (G := G) U hU
    83	    have hx := congrArg (fun f => f.base x) hfac
    84	    exact hx

    86	  exact hcomp

     7	import MilneLib.SymmetricPower
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Coherence of supplied relative symmetric-power data
    11	
    12	The quotient interface in `SymmetricPower` is intentionally data-valued: a
    13	construction may supply more than one carrier for the same relative power.
    14	This file records the comparison and functoriality equations needed to use
    15	those carriers in a gluing diagram.  Every statement is conditional on the
    16	given `SymmetricPowerData` objects; no quotient existence assertion is added.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits
    24	open AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	namespace MilneLib
    27	
    28	namespace SymmetricPowerData
    29	
    30	variable {S : Scheme.{u}} {V W : Over S} {n : ℕ}
    31	
    32	/-- Quotient maps are natural in the chosen presentation of each symmetric
    33	power.  Thus replacing either carrier by its universal-property comparison
    34	does not change the induced map. -/
    35	theorem map_comp_canonicalIso_naturality
    36	    (DV EV : SymmetricPowerData V n) (DW EW : SymmetricPowerData W n)
    37	    (f : V ⟶ W) :
    38	    DV.map DW f ≫ (canonicalIso DW EW).hom =
    39	      (canonicalIso DV EV).hom ≫ EV.map EW f := by
    40	  let h : relativePower V n ⟶ EW.carrier :=
    41	    relativePowerMap f n ≫ EW.projection
    42	  have hsym : IsSymmetric V n h := by
    43	    dsimp [h]
    44	    exact isSymmetric_comp_relativePowerMap f EW.projection
    45	      EW.projection_symmetric
    46	  have hleft :
    47	      DV.projection ≫ (DV.map DW f ≫ (canonicalIso DW EW).hom) = h := by
    48	    simp [h]
    49	  have hright :
    50	      DV.projection ≫ ((canonicalIso DV EV).hom ≫ EV.map EW f) = h := by
    51	    rw [← Category.assoc, projection_comp_canonicalIso_hom,
    52	      projection_comp_map]
    53	  exact
    54	    (DV.factor_unique h hsym _ hleft).trans
    55	      (DV.factor_unique h hsym _ hright).symm
    56	
    57	/-- Canonical comparisons between supplied quotient presentations compose as
    58	expected on triple overlaps. -/
    59	theorem canonicalIso_hom_trans
    60	    (D E F : SymmetricPowerData V n) :
    61	    (canonicalIso D E).hom ≫ (canonicalIso E F).hom =
    62	      (canonicalIso D F).hom := by
    63	  apply canonicalIso_hom_unique D F
    64	  rw [← Category.assoc, projection_comp_canonicalIso_hom,
    65	    projection_comp_canonicalIso_hom]
    66	
    67	end SymmetricPowerData
    68	
    69	end MilneLib

    10	/-!
    11	# Tensor products of affine schemes over a base
    12	
    13	The cartesian tensor product in the slice over `Spec k` of two affine spectra
    14	is canonically identified with the spectrum of the corresponding ring tensor
    15	product.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	open scoped TensorProduct
    19	open CategoryTheory
    20	open AlgebraicGeometry
    21	
    22	namespace MilneLib
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	/-- The affine carrier of a tensor product over `Spec k`. -/
    27	noncomputable def affineSpecOver_tensorObj_iso {k A B : Type u} [CommRing k]
    28	    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B] :
    29	    MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (affineSpecOver (k := k) (A := A))
    30	        (affineSpecOver (k := k) (A := B)) ≅
    31	      affineSpecOver (k := k) (A := A ⊗[k] B) := by
    32	  refine Over.isoMk (pullbackSpecIso k A B) (hw := ?_)
    33	  simp only [affineSpecOver_hom, Over.tensorObj_hom]
    34	  exact pullbackSpecIso_hom_base k A B
    35	
    36	end MilneLib
